answer: A violet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the falcon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The crystal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
